messages:
Aisha Khan: Heads up — Skybolt (acct: SKB-241) ran into a huge usage spike and is asking for a one-time volume flex credit + extended payment terms for a 6-month pilot. Customer wants $60k credit + Net60 for the pilot. Invoice referenced: INV-2026-5372. Need Deal Desk review before we commit.
Marco Ruiz: Do we have P&L / margin impact on that $60k ask?
Aisha Khan: Quick calc attached in thread (see sheet). Back-of-envelope it would be ~18% gross margin hit if we eat full amount, but retention probability looks high — they move more Dedicated capacity after pilot.
Priya Patel: Legal note — we prefer a short amendment (no full contract rewrite). We can add a one-paragraph payment amendment + SOC2 confirmation clause.
Ethan Wells: Ops/Billing: we can apply a one-time credit on the next invoice once finance signs off and we have the signed amendment. We need the exact credit SKU and effective invoice id.
BillingBot: System: INV-2026-5372 created 2235678888 — status: DRAFT.
Marco Ruiz: Sales suggests compromise: $40k one-time credit and move Net30->Net45 (not Net60) for the pilot. Keeps footprint risk lower.
Aisha Khan: Finance, is $40k + Net45 something you can live with? We'll make it explicit "one-time, non-recurring" in the amendment.
Priya Patel: I can approve $40k + Net45 subject to: 1) signed amendment 2) AR waiver note recorded in Deal Desk doc. I'll draft the amendment text.
Marco Ruiz: I'll take responsibility for the amendment execution with the customer.
Aisha Khan: Can we get an explicit AR policy waiver logged? Who signs that off?
Ravi Desai: Ravi here — CFO. I'm okay with $40k one-time credit and Net45 for the pilot. Must be documented as a one-off concession; no change to list pricing or future rate cards. Also want a clause: credit applied only after pilot completion if no outstanding disputes.
Priya Patel: Adding that clause now. Draft snippet: ```Amendment: Customer shall receive a one-time credit of $40,000 applied to the invoice following execution of this amendment and successful completion of the 3-month pilot. Payment terms for the pilot invoice shall be Net45. This credit is a one-time concession and shall not be construed as a change to Redwood Inference's standard pricing or future commitments.```
Ethan Wells: Billing ticket created: `BILL-1123`. Will queue credit once signed amendment uploaded to the billing portal.
Aisha Khan: Great — @Ravi Desai can you add your approval in the Deal Desk ticket? I'll update the customer with the revised terms.
Ravi Desai: Done — I left an approval note in the Deal Desk doc and cc'd finance-approvals@redwood.com. :thumbsup:
Marco Ruiz: Thanks everyone. I'll share the amendment and confirm signature timeline with Skybolt.
Aisha Khan: Closing loop here — final terms: $40k one-time credit, Net45 for pilot, contingent on signed amendment and SOC2 confirmation. I'll mark this as approved for billing to execute once paperwork is in.
Priya Patel: Filing the amendment draft in the contract repo under /amendments/SKB-241.
BillingBot: Note: Credit application pending — reference thread 2235678901 and ticket BILL-1123.
Marco Ruiz: 👍
Aisha Khan: Thanks all — moving to done on my side, will reopen if customer pushes for Net60 or higher credit.
